name: Ang Mo Kio Industrial Park 2
intro: Ang Mo Kio Industrial Park 2 is an industrial estate in Ang Mo Kio, including the AMK AutoPoint motor building, with workshops serving the north-east.

name: Kaki Bukit Industrial Estate
intro: Kaki Bukit is an industrial estate in the East region, around Kaki Bukit Avenue 4 and 6 and Kaki Bukit Road 2 and 4, with many workshops, trade units and parts suppliers.

name: Sin Ming Industrial Estate
intro: Sin Ming Industrial Estate, including Sin Ming Drive and the Sin Ming AutoCity and Autocare buildings, is in the middle of Singapore near Bishan.

name: Toh Guan Road East and Enterprise Hub
intro: Toh Guan Road East and the Enterprise Hub industrial building are in the West region, near Jurong East.

name: Corporation Drive, Jurong East
intro: Corporation Drive is an industrial road in Jurong East, in the West region.

name: Paya Ubi Industrial Park
intro: Paya Ubi Industrial Park is around Ubi Avenue 1, near Paya Lebar in the Geylang planning area (Central region), with motor workshops mixed in among light industry.

name: Ubi Road 1
intro: Ubi Road 1 is an industrial road in the Ubi area, near Paya Lebar in the Geylang planning area (Central region).

name: Bedok Industrial Park E
intro: Bedok Industrial Park E is a block of trade units along Bedok North Avenue 4 in the East region, near Bedok Reservoir and Tampines.

name: Tampines Industrial Park A
intro: Tampines Industrial Park A is a light industrial estate along Tampines Street 92 and 93 in the East region.

name: Woodlands Industrial Park E9
intro: Woodlands Industrial Park E9 is the main industrial park in the north-west, close to the Causeway.

name: Jalan Lam Huat and Carros Centre
intro: Jalan Lam Huat, where Carros Centre stands, is an industrial road in the north-west of Singapore.

name: Woodlands Avenue 12 (Polaris@Woodlands)
intro: Woodlands Avenue 12 and the Polaris@Woodlands industrial building are in the Woodlands area in the north.

name: Yishun Industrial Park A
intro: Yishun Industrial Park A is one of the two main motor trade clusters in Yishun, in the North region.

name: Yishun Industrial Street 1
intro: Yishun Industrial Street 1, around North Spring Bizhub and Northpoint Bizhub, is the second motor trade cluster in Yishun.

name: Bukit Batok Crescent (WCEGA Plaza)
intro: Bukit Batok Crescent, home to the WCEGA Plaza and WCEGA Tower industrial buildings, is a light industrial area in the West region.

name: Woodlands Close (MEGA@Woodlands)
intro: Woodlands Close, where the MEGA@Woodlands industrial building stands, is a light industrial area in the north, near Woodlands Avenue 12.

name: Defu Industrial Estate (Defu Lane)
intro: Defu Industrial Estate, laid out along the Defu Lane roads near Hougang, is one of the older light industrial estates in the north-east, with many motor workshops.

name: MacPherson Road
intro: MacPherson Road runs through the MacPherson area in the central region, with a row of shophouse car workshops and service centres along it.

name: Woodlands Avenue 10 (Woodlands Industrial Xchange)
intro: Woodlands Avenue 10, home to the Woodlands Industrial Xchange building, is a light industrial area in Woodlands in the North region.

name: Admiralty Street (Northlink Building)
intro: Admiralty Street, with the Northlink Building and nearby industrial blocks, is a light industrial area on the Woodlands and Admiralty side of the North region.

name: Toa Payoh Industrial Park and Lorong 4
intro: Toa Payoh Industrial Park and the Lorong 4 Toa Payoh blocks are small light industrial pockets in Toa Payoh in the central region, with car workshops among them.

name: Serangoon Garden Way
intro: Serangoon Garden Way runs through the Serangoon Gardens estate in the north-east, with a car service centre among its shops.

name: Mandai Estate
intro: Mandai Estate is a light industrial area off Mandai Road in the north of Singapore, between Kranji and Woodlands, with workshops in its terrace blocks.

name: Tampines North Drive 1 (T-Space)
intro: Tampines North Drive 1, home to the T-Space industrial building, is a light industrial area in the north of Tampines in the East region.

name: Yishun Ring Road
intro: Yishun Ring Road loops around the Yishun town centre in the North region; car service points here sit at petrol stations along the road.

name: Soon Lee Street (Pioneer Point)
intro: Soon Lee Street, with the Pioneer Point and Pioneer Centre industrial buildings, is a motor trade cluster in Pioneer, in the far west of Singapore.

name: Jurong West Avenue 5
intro: Jurong West Avenue 5 runs through the Jurong West housing estate in the West region, with car service points along it.

name: Bukit Merah Lane 3
intro: Bukit Merah Lane 3 is a row of older light industrial blocks in Bukit Merah, in the central region, with several car workshops on its ground floors.

name: Loyang Way and Loyang Drive
intro: Loyang Way and Loyang Drive form the Loyang industrial estate in the far east of Singapore, near Pasir Ris and Changi, with motor workshops in its multi-storey factory blocks.

name: Tuas (Tuas Avenues and Tuas South)
intro: Tuas is the large industrial area at the western tip of Singapore, around the Tuas Avenue and Tuas South roads, with motor workshops among its factories and warehouses.

name: Bukit Timah Road (Newton)
intro: Bukit Timah Road at Newton Circus is a busy central road between Orchard and Novena, close to Newton MRT and the Central Expressway.

name: Pandan Loop (Pandan Light Industries Park)
intro: Pandan Loop, with the Pandan Light Industries Park blocks, is a light industrial area in the west, near the Pandan Reservoir and the Ayer Rajah Expressway.
